rule_text: Plan by enrolled students. Small: fewer than 250 (up to 249). Medium: 250 to 500. Large: 501 to 1,000. Enterprise: more than 1,000. The Xora Operations list uses the same boundaries (below 250 Small, 250 to 500 Medium, to 1,000 Large).

Annual price = monthly list × 12, less 10%. In code: list = monthly × 12; discount = round(list × 0.1); annual = round(list × 0.9). The invoice shows the list price struck through, then the annual price, with the note “10% off for paying a year ahead”.

Enterprise plans have no default prices. The person onboarding enters the agreed annual fee, setup fee and exam fee. The form refuses to continue unless annual fee and exam fee are both above zero. The Director confirms the amounts at approval.
Leadership may override monthly, exam or setup price for a tier. An override applies to institutes onboarded afterwards. Every change is stored in PricingLog with a reason. (Volume 2)

Minimum first wallet recharge is ₹25,000. The invoice defaults to the larger of ₹25,000 and the suggested amount for the plan. A smaller amount is refused with “The first wallet recharge must be at least ₹25,000.”
First invoice total = annual plan + setup fee + first wallet recharge. The recharge is not a fee; it becomes the institute’s opening wallet balance.

Invoice numbers are INV-2026- followed by a four-digit sequence (INV-2026-0001). Onboarding request IDs are OB- followed by four digits. The sequence is global and never reused. The year part is the calendar year of the invoice date in IST. The four-digit sequence restarts at 0001 on 1 January, a number is never reused, and a database sequence per year stops two invoices getting the same number (D0-6). OB- numbers are one sequence that never restarts.
Payment terms: the invoice falls due after the number of days in Settings (default 7). A payment must be at least the invoice total; a smaller amount is refused.
Available wallet = balance − reserved (funds set aside for authorised exams).
Authorising an exam sets aside registered students × exam fee. It is refused if available is too low.

When the exam starts, each starter is charged from the amount set aside. When the exam is closed, the remainder is charged for absentees, so every registered student is billed. This is final: the fee is per registered student, not per attendee (D0-2).

The wallet never expires. An unused balance is never refunded automatically. After an institute is switched off and asks in writing, Finance refunds the available balance (balance minus amounts held) to the original payment source within 14 days, less any gateway charge the gateway does not return. The Director and Finance both approve, using the ledger adjustment command (REL-BR-140). Plan and setup fees are not refunded (D0-3).

Reminder: when available falls below the threshold in Settings (default ₹25,000), Xora emails the institute once, and notifies its Academic Head and Owner in the app. The reminder fires once and is re-armed only when available rises back to or above the threshold. Xora may press Remind again. The Academic Head may remind the Admin.
Top-ups: minimum ₹25,000 by online payment, receipted, Admin informed. (Module 5 volume.)

Tax. All prices and amounts are tax-inclusive at 18 percent GST (D0-5). Invoices and receipts show taxable value = round(total ÷ 1.18) and GST = total − taxable value, then CGST 9 percent and SGST 9 percent (CGST is half the GST rounded down, SGST the remainder) for an institute in Tamil Nadu, or IGST 18 percent for any other state. The state comes from the first two digits of the institute’s GST number when entered, otherwise from its PIN code. Example: ₹1,62,000 gives taxable ₹1,37,288 and GST ₹24,712. Screens keep the prototype’s figures.

Every sensitive action is audited: sign-ins to Xora consoles, onboarding steps, payments, approvals, settings changes, user creation and switching on or off, exam pause, resume and extension, flag decisions, incidents, wallet reminders, password changes and resets.
A destructive or exam-affecting action asks for a reason (minimum three characters) and stores it in the audit entry. Pattern: confirmReason(title, subtitle, verb, style, action).
Every email sent is recorded in the mail outbox with recipient, subject, full text, channel and status, and can be viewed from the console that sent it.

The retention periods above are configuration, one number per row, in docs/release/targets.json style settings, and the nightly job reads them. A period is shortened freely but lengthened only by change control because the privacy notice quotes it.
